## Description

After a merger announcement, buys the target (and sometimes hedges the acquirer) to capture the deal-spread conditional on closing.

## Where it may fit

Announced deals with identifiable terms and credible closing timelines; spreads widen with financing, regulatory or shareholder uncertainty.

## Vehicles

Event-driven hedge funds, market-neutral funds, individual equities and deal-related options.

## Required data

Deal terms, target/acquirer prices, exchange ratios, cash/stock consideration, regulatory dates, financing conditions and borrow data.

## Caveats

Deal breaks can cause large losses; probability estimates, event timelines, deal terms and corporate actions must be point-in-time accurate.
